on_the_run_layer_but_not_pinnable_from_a.src/private_block/hash_domain.rs: the C-H4 / T-3 / T-4 hash-length guards. per_file.reading: `git diff 3247a89 f4697f9`: **44 added, 6 removed, 9 hunks**, split **production +22 / -0** and `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` **+22 / -6**.  STAGE 26 again.  In production: one accessor, `index() -> u64` (the boundary's own index, a PUBLIC word of the run statement), and a 16-line doc comment saying that a boundary is the one commitment on the path with no generator of its own -- it is handed the run's single stream -- and naming the domain it WOULD use (`hash_domain::boundary_seed_domain(index, spec.digest())`) without calling it.  In the tests: a `test_generator(spec)` helper and six call sites that now seed from that domain instead of the module's `DOMAIN` label.  **Not one geometry accessor moved**: `data_rows`, `commitment_rows`, `site_rows`, `prox_row`, `mask_row`, `MAX_SITES` and ruling M-1's refusal are byte-identical, and the ports read only those

`git diff 3247a89 f4697f9`: **50 added, 2 removed, 3 hunks**, and read hunk by hunk it is **three statements of production code and forty lines of comment**.  (1) The run-level hash-length guard now takes a `hash_domain::RunFacts { profile, l, parameter_line }` instead of the bare parameter line (stage 25, W-4), so the statement class goes into the imposed set: `let facts = ...;` added and the `imposed_at_shape_with` call re-emitted.  It is a REFUSAL SET and absorbs nothing.  (2) `ZkRng::from_os(profile.as_bytes())` becomes `ZkRng::from_os(&hash_domain::run_seed_domain(profile))` (stage 26, the ruling on finding B-1): the OS-seeded BLINDING stream's domain now carries a versioned use literal and the run prover's role byte beside the profile string.  **That stream is not the transcript.**  No absorb, no label, no squeeze and no verifier-visible byte moves, and a replay cannot see it -- which is why the round-9 replay reproduces every challenge of a bundle written under it.  (3) A 35-line doc comment, ruling H-1 on what a production caller owes.  **The header's six absorbs and their order, the seven-word shape, `position_tag`, the stage loop, the boundary-before-A rule, `BOUNDARY_SITES` and the opening order are byte-identical**, and those are the whole of what `zk60_native_rg_replay` transcribes

`git diff 3247a89 f4697f9`: **368 added, 23 removed, 36 hunks**, and this file has no test module (its tests are `run_capture_tests.rs`, which no bundle pins), so the whole diff is production.  STAGE 27, and it is two changes.  (1) **The `/5-run` array store**: `SCHEMA_V5`, `ARRAY_MIN = 256`, `CaptureOpts`, `schema_of(arrays)`, an `ArrayStore` that appends an array's little-endian image to one blob, deduplicates by SHA-256 and returns `{array, elem, len, offset, bytes}`, and the six emission sites that now route through it -- an opened column's `values`, an opening group's `vector`, `proximity_rhos`, `proximity_vector`, the M opening's `q` and `prox`, and a public table's `values`.  The 23 removed lines are those same six `write!`s and the `SOURCE_FILES` constant, each re-emitted.  **Not one field name, member order, kind, coverage string or transcript label moves**, and `ALLOWED_KEYS` gains exactly two entries, `array` and `elem` (format 12: `offset`, `len`, `bytes` and `sha256` were already on it).  A `/4-run` bundle is still written when `HL_RUN_CAPTURE_ARRAYS=store` is absent, and the writer's own `the_array_store_and_the_classic_encoding_carry_the_same_values` captures one run twice in one process and asserts byte-for-byte equality of the expanded store with the classic encoding.  `zk60_native_rg_arrays` is this lane's reader for it, proved against a re-encoded development bundle (round 9, item N1).  (2) **`SOURCE_FILES` 8 -> `OWN_SOURCE_FILES` 15 + `SHARED_SOURCE_FILES` 23 = 38 pins**, plus `NOT_ON_THE_RUNS_PATH` naming `timing.rs` with its reason.  That is the writer-side ask R6.8 item 1 and R8.9 item 4, GRANTED: see `SHARED_LAYER_PINS` below

adjacent_stage_pairs.ruling_R3: ruling R-3: `joint == sum of the parts` is a CONSISTENCY CHECK of this model's coordinate classes, NOT evidence that the commitments' blinding is independent.  The checker built the counterexample: two DISTINCT blinding rows whose VALUES coincide score exactly like an honest run (joint 0 = sum 0) while disclosing 1,024 field elements at this shape.  Independence across the 4L+1 commitments rests on the generator and the draw discipline (gap G-R4), is to be machine-asserted elsewhere, and is not established by anything in this figure

is_that_a_theorem_here.why: only DATA coordinates are shared -- no blinding source is -- so the non-data block is block diagonal by role and its rank is the sum of the three; identifying data coordinates can then only LOWER rank(all), so k0_joint <= sum k0_r, and with every part 0 the joint is forced to 0.  Both facts are COMPUTED above, and the controls show the equality breaking when a blinding row IS shared
